statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent lightheadedness poorly correlated with standard ECG findings.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5).
Prolonged cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was billed.
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97.
The service does not meet the specific medical necessity criteria outlined in the coverage policy.
Less intensive monitoring options were not attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care.
